put.description:
Give the user a new temporary password (to be changed at the next sign-in), sign them out
everywhere and cancel their "forgot password" links. Your own: change it from your menu.

post.description:
Replace the signed-in user's password: this browser gets a new session, every other one is
signed out.

E-mail a link to choose a new password to an enabled account. The answer is the same
whether the address has an account or not; the e-mail is sent after it.

Choose a new password with an e-mailed link and sign in. 400 ``password_reset_invalid``
when the link is unknown, expired or already used.

Create the first administrator, or follow a recovery link: the account of ``email``
(created if missing) becomes an enabled administrator with this password, signed in here and
out everywhere else. 403 ``setup_closed`` once an enabled administrator exists, unless
``token`` is the code of the pending recovery link.
